The changes in the test file directly address the issue described in the release log by adjusting the assertions to accommodate the differences in behavior when running against Hadoop 2 with YARN. This ensures that the test accurately reflects the expected configuration for both YARN and non-YARN environments, thereby resolving the failure reported in OOZIE-1634.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```java
<property><name>oozie.launcher.mapred.child.java.opts</name><value>-Xmx2048m -Djava.net.preferIPv4Stack=true</value></property>
```
```java
assertEquals("-Xmx2048m -Djava.net.preferIPv4Stack=true -Xmx2560m",
                launcherConf.get(JavaActionExecutor.YARN_AM_COMMAND_OPTS).trim());
```
```java
// memoryMB (2048 + 512)
```
Reason:
The test case `testUpdateConfForUberMode` did not account for the additional memory parameter `-Xmx1024m` that is included in `YARN_AM_COMMAND_OPTS` when using YARN. This discrepancy between the expected and actual output caused the test to fail against Hadoop 2.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```java
if (createJobConf().get("yarn.resourcemanager.address") != null) {
    assertEquals("-Xmx1024m -Xmx2048m -Djava.net.preferIPv4Stack=true -Xmx2560m",
                    launcherConf.get(JavaActionExecutor.YARN_AM_COMMAND_OPTS).trim());
}
```
```java
else {
    assertEquals("-Xmx2048m -Djava.net.preferIPv4Stack=true -Xmx2560m",
                    launcherConf.get(JavaActionExecutor.YARN_AM_COMMAND_OPTS).trim());
}
```
Reason:
The added conditional checks ensure that when YARN is in use, the expected output includes the additional memory parameter `-Xmx1024m`, thus aligning the test's expectations with the actual configuration used in YARN, which resolves the test failure.
